paragraphs: Elazar ben Yehudah Ish Avalim — Zevachim 28a.[^1][^2]

notes.text: כח. is rendered Zevachim 28a under the period convention, without independent named-edition verification.
Ish Avalim preserves איש אבלים without deciding its geographical or descriptive sense. Elazar ben Yehudah Ish Avalim is the supplied body name; neither unit supplies a personal title.
